title: A Survey of Graph Neural Networks
abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) extend deep learning to graph-structured data. This survey reviews message passing architectures, sampling and scalability techniques, training objectives, and applications in recommendation, chemistry, and knowledge graphs. We discuss evaluation settings, benchmarks, and open challenges such as over-smoothing, heterophily, and large-scale graphs.

title: Transformers: A Review of Attention-Based Models
abstract: Transformer architectures based on self-attention have become the dominant paradigm for sequence modeling. We review encoder-decoder and decoder-only variants, efficient attention mechanisms, training recipes, scaling laws, and downstream tasks including NLP, vision, and multimodal learning. We summarize common datasets, metrics, and reproducibility considerations.

title: Federated Learning Systems and Algorithms: A Tutorial
abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across clients without centralizing data. This tutorial covers optimization under non-IID data, communication efficiency, privacy mechanisms, system design choices, and evaluation protocols. We highlight benchmark suites and pitfalls for fair comparison.
